summary: Practise translating NGFS scenarios into bank credit, liquidity and capital impacts. Review the five-day climate stress testing course.
lede: Climate stress testing for banks translates physical hazards and transition scenarios into potential effects on portfolios, earnings, liquidity and capital. Designed for bank risk, treasury, finance and reporting teams, supervisors and consultants, the course develops a traceable analysis through scenario selection, exposure mapping, counterparty sensitivity and credit-loss estimation. Participants also examine revenue and liquidity impacts and document assumptions, limitations and governance in a reviewable results pack.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who quantify, oversee or review the effects of climate scenarios on bank balance sheets, portfolios and prudential results.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of bank financial statements and at least one of credit risk, treasury risk, finance or stress testing is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use Excel.
